story: With the rise of NeuroCleanse™, more people are choosing to erase traumatic memories. Global debates erupt over the ethics of memory authenticity.
The United Nations passes the Cognitive Intervention Regulation Act, requiring all memory edits to be officially recorded. Protests break out in several countries.
MemoryCloud™, a global memory storage platform, launches permanent consciousness backup in exchange for behavioral data.
France conducts the first legal case using 'memory rewriting trial procedure' on a murder suspect, shocking the international legal community.
The world's first 'designer babies' are implanted with artificial happy childhood memories, igniting fierce ethical debates.
Black market memory networks are exposed; hackers steal and auction private memories on the dark web.
A global survey reveals 74% of people are willing to share childhood memories anonymously for educational use.
The 'Truth Equals Memory' movement grows, calling for labels on altered individuals as 'virtual humans'.
Memory+ devices allow users to experience multiple simultaneous memory streams, but massive cognitive failures begin to emerge.
A radical proposal gains traction: allow adults to voluntarily erase all memories and restart life with a blank mind.
